title: Bushfire Sentinel
description: Yarra Ranges regional bushfire CPS monitoring dashboard.

options.markdown:
# 🔥 Bushfire Sentinel

Yarra Ranges CPS monitoring · Node-RED control · Splunk dashboard

options.query: index=bushfire_sentinel ("FAILED" OR "NO_RESPONSE") | rex field=_raw "\"command_id\":\"(?<command_id>[^\"]+)" | rex field=_raw "\"sprinkler_status\":\"(?<sprinkler_status>[^\"]+)" | rex field=_raw "\"sensor\":\"(?<sensor>[^\"]+)" | rex field=_raw "\"value\":\"?(?<raw_value>[^\",}]+)" | eval Feedback=coalesce(sprinkler_status, if(sensor="sprinkler_status", raw_value, null())) | where Feedback="FAILED" OR Feedback="NO_RESPONSE" | dedup command_id Feedback | stats count as value | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel ("severity" OR "event_type" OR "alert_type") | spath path=severity output=severity | spath path=event_type output=event_type | spath path=alert_type output=alert_type | eval Type=case(event_type="validation_reject","Validation", event_type="anomaly","Anomaly", event_type="weather_fetch_error","Weather API", alert_type="FIRE_RISK","Fire Risk", alert_type="RESPONSE_CAPACITY","Response", true(),"Other") | stats count as Count by Type | sort - Count | table Type Count

index=bushfire_sentinel ("severity" OR "event_type" OR "alert_type") | sort - _time | spath path=severity output=severity | spath path=event_type output=event_type | spath path=alert_type output=alert_type | spath path=message output=message | spath path=error output=error | spath path=errors{} output=validation_errors | spath path=anomalies{}.type output=anomaly_type | spath path=anomalies{}.sensor output=anomaly_sensor | spath path=source_message.sensor output=source_sensor | spath path=original.sensor output=original_sensor | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%H:%M:%S") | eval Type=case(event_type="validation_reject","Validation", event_type="anomaly","Anomaly", alert_type="FIRE_RISK","Fire Risk", alert_type="RESPONSE_CAPACITY","Response", isnotnull(alert_type),alert_type, true(),coalesce(event_type,"Alert")) | eval Sensor=coalesce(mvindex(anomaly_sensor,0),source_sensor,original_sensor,if(alert_type="RESPONSE_CAPACITY","sprinkler_status","-")) | eval validation_reason=mvjoin(validation_errors,", ") | eval anomaly_reason=mvjoin(anomaly_type,", ") | eval Message=case(event_type="validation_reject" AND isnotnull(validation_reason) AND validation_reason!="", validation_reason, event_type="anomaly" AND isnotnull(anomaly_reason) AND anomaly_reason!="", anomaly_reason, isnotnull(message), message, isnotnull(error), error, true(), "-") | table Time severity Type Sensor Message | head 6 | rename severity as Severity

index=bushfire_sentinel "sprinkler_command" | spath path=command_id output=command_id | spath path=sprinkler_command output=sprinkler_command | spath path=reason output=reason | eval command_time=strftime(_time,"%H:%M:%S") | table command_id command_time sprinkler_command reason | join type=left command_id [ search index=bushfire_sentinel ("sprinkler_status" OR "sensor":"sprinkler_status") | spath path=command_id output=command_id | spath path=sprinkler_status output=sprinkler_status | spath path=sensor output=sensor | spath path=value output=value | spath path=response_time_ms output=response_time_ms | eval feedback_time=strftime(_time,"%H:%M:%S") | eval feedback=coalesce(sprinkler_status,value) | stats latest(feedback_time) as feedback_time latest(feedback) as feedback latest(response_time_ms) as response_time_ms by command_id ] | eval feedback=coalesce(feedback,"Waiting / no feedback"), response_time_ms=coalesce(response_time_ms,"-") | sort - command_time | head 6 | rename command_time as "Command Time" command_id as "Command ID" sprinkler_command as "Node-RED Command" reason as "Rule Reason" feedback as "Actuator Feedback" response_time_ms as "Response ms" | eval "Node-RED Command"=replace('Node-RED Command', "_", " ") | eval "Node-RED Command"=upper(substr('Node-RED Command',1,1)).lower(substr('Node-RED Command',2)) | eval "Rule Reason"=upper(substr('Rule Reason',1,1)).lower(substr('Rule Reason',2)) | eval "Actuator Feedback"=upper(substr('Actuator Feedback',1,1)).lower(substr('Actuator Feedback',2)) | table "Command Time" "Node-RED Command" "Rule Reason" "Actuator Feedback" "Response ms"

index=bushfire_sentinel "fire_risk_score" | spath path=fire_risk_score output=fire_risk_score | eval value=tonumber(fire_risk_score) | where isnotnull(value) | stats latest(value) as value | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "sprinkler_command" | rex field=_raw "\"sprinkler_command\":\"(?<Command>[^\"]+)" | eval Command=case(Command="SEND_WARNING","Warning",Command="ACTIVATE_SPRINKLER","Activate Sprinkler",Command="EMERGENCY_ALERT","Emergency Alert",Command="STANDBY","Standby",true(),Command) | stats latest(Command) as value | eval value=coalesce(value,"None") | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel ("sprinkler_status" OR "NO_RESPONSE" OR "FAILED") | rex field=_raw "\"sprinkler_status\":\"(?<sprinkler_status>[^\"]+)" | rex field=_raw "\"sensor\":\"(?<sensor>[^\"]+)" | rex field=_raw "\"value\":\"?(?<raw_value>[^\",}]+)" | eval Feedback=coalesce(sprinkler_status, if(sensor="sprinkler_status", raw_value, null()), "Unknown") | eval Feedback=case(Feedback="OFF","Off",Feedback="ON","On",Feedback="FAILED","Failed",Feedback="NO_RESPONSE","No Response",true(),Feedback) | stats latest(Feedback) as value | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel ("smoke_level" OR "soil_dryness" OR "water_tank_level") | spath path=timestamp output=json_timestamp | spath path=device_id output=json_device_id | spath path=sensor output=json_sensor | spath path=value output=json_value | eval clean_time=replace(json_timestamp,"Z","+0000") | eval event_time=coalesce(strptime(clean_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N%z"),strptime(clean_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")) | eval _time=coalesce(event_time,_time) | eval reading=tonumber(json_value) | where json_device_id="station_01" AND json_sensor IN ("smoke_level","soil_dryness","water_tank_level") AND isnotnull(reading) | eval metric=case(json_sensor="smoke_level","Smoke",json_sensor="soil_dryness","Soil Dryness",json_sensor="water_tank_level","Water Tank",true(),json_sensor) | timechart span=30s avg(reading) by metric

index=bushfire_sentinel "relative_humidity" | spath path=device_id output=device_id | spath path=sensor output=sensor | spath path=value output=json_value | eval reading=tonumber(json_value) | where device_id="station_01" AND sensor="relative_humidity" AND isnotnull(reading) | stats min(reading) as value | eval value=round(value,1) | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "precipitation" | spath path=device_id output=json_device_id | spath path=sensor output=json_sensor | spath path=value output=json_value | where json_device_id="station_01" AND json_sensor="precipitation" | eval value=tonumber(json_value) | stats sum(value) as value | append [ | makeresults | eval value=0 ] | stats max(value) as value | eval value=round(value,2) | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "response_capacity_status" | spath path=response_capacity_status output=response_capacity_status | stats latest(response_capacity_status) as value | eval value=upper(substr(value,1,1)).lower(substr(value,2)) | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "fire_risk_level" | spath path=fire_risk_level output=fire_risk_level | stats latest(fire_risk_level) as value | eval value=upper(substr(value,1,1)).lower(substr(value,2)) | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "fire_risk_score" | spath path=fire_risk_score output=fire_risk_score | spath path=fire_risk_level output=fire_risk_level | spath path=response_capacity_status output=response_capacity_status | spath path=overall_system_status output=overall_system_status | spath path=recommended_command output=recommended_command | spath path=risk_factors{} output=rf | eval Score=tonumber(fire_risk_score), Risk=fire_risk_level, Response=response_capacity_status, Status=overall_system_status, Command=coalesce(recommended_command,"-"), Factors=mvjoin(rf,", ") | eval Command=if(Command="null" OR isnull(Command), "-", Command) | sort - _time | dedup Score Risk Status Command Factors | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%H:%M:%S") | eval Risk=upper(substr(Risk,1,1)).lower(substr(Risk,2)) | eval Response=upper(substr(Response,1,1)).lower(substr(Response,2)) | eval Status=replace(Status, "_", " ") | eval Status=upper(substr(Status,1,1)).lower(substr(Status,2)) | eval Command=replace(Command, "_", " ") | eval Command=if(Command="-", "-", upper(substr(Command,1,1)).lower(substr(Command,2))) | table Time Score Risk Status Command Factors | head 6

index=bushfire_sentinel "fire_risk_score" | spath path=fire_risk_score output=fire_risk_score | eval score=tonumber(fire_risk_score) | where isnotnull(score) | timechart span=30s avg(score) as "Risk Score"

index=bushfire_sentinel "sensor" | spath path=device_id output=device_id | spath path=sensor output=sensor | spath path=value output=json_value | eval reading=tonumber(json_value) | where device_id="station_01" AND isnotnull(reading) AND sensor IN ("ambient_temperature","relative_humidity","wind_speed","precipitation","smoke_level","soil_dryness","water_tank_level") | eval Sensor=case(sensor="ambient_temperature","Temperature",sensor="relative_humidity","Humidity",sensor="wind_speed","Wind",sensor="precipitation","Rain",sensor="smoke_level","Smoke",sensor="soil_dryness","Soil Dryness",sensor="water_tank_level","Water Tank",true(),sensor) | stats sparkline(avg(reading),2m) as "Recent Trend" latest(reading) as Latest avg(reading) as "Average 60m" by Sensor | eval Latest=round(Latest,2), "Average 60m"=round('Average 60m',2) | sort Sensor | table Sensor "Recent Trend" Latest "Average 60m"

index=bushfire_sentinel ("sprinkler_command" OR "sprinkler_status" OR "sensor":"sprinkler_status") | spath path=sprinkler_command output=sprinkler_command | spath path=sprinkler_status output=sprinkler_status | spath path=sensor output=sensor | spath path=value output=value | eval raw_feedback=coalesce(sprinkler_status, if(sensor="sprinkler_status", value, null())) | eventstats latest(sprinkler_command) as latest_command latest(raw_feedback) as latest_feedback | eval latest_command=coalesce(latest_command,"NONE"), latest_feedback=coalesce(latest_feedback,"UNKNOWN") | eval value=case(latest_command="EMERGENCY_ALERT","Emergency Alert", latest_feedback="FAILED","Actuator Failed", latest_feedback="NO_RESPONSE","No Response", latest_command="ACTIVATE_SPRINKLER" AND latest_feedback="ON","Sprinkler Active", latest_command="ACTIVATE_SPRINKLER","Waiting Feedback", latest_command="SEND_WARNING","Warning Sent", latest_command="STANDBY","Standby", latest_command="NONE","Standby", true(),"Standby") | stats latest(value) as value | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "overall_system_status" | spath path=overall_system_status output=overall_system_status | stats latest(overall_system_status) as value | eval value=replace(value, "_", " ") | eval value=upper(substr(value,1,1)).lower(substr(value,2)) | table value

index=bushfire_sentinel "open_meteo" ("ambient_temperature" OR "wind_speed") | spath path=device_id output=json_device_id | spath path=site_name output=json_site_name | spath path=sensor output=json_sensor | spath path=value output=json_value | spath path=source output=json_source | where json_source="open_meteo" AND json_sensor IN ("ambient_temperature","wind_speed") | eval reading=tonumber(json_value) | where isnotnull(reading) AND ((json_sensor="ambient_temperature" AND reading>=-10 AND reading<=55) OR (json_sensor="wind_speed" AND reading>=0 AND reading<=150)) | eval Site=case(json_device_id="station_01","Main Site",json_device_id="station_ref_01","Park Site",json_device_id="station_ref_02","Region Site",true(),json_site_name) | eval Metric=case(json_sensor="ambient_temperature","Temperature C",json_sensor="wind_speed","Wind km/h",true(),json_sensor) | stats latest(reading) as latest by Site Metric | eval latest=round(latest,2) | xyseries Site Metric latest

index=bushfire_sentinel "open_meteo" ("ambient_temperature" OR "wind_speed") | spath path=timestamp output=json_timestamp | spath path=device_id output=json_device_id | spath path=sensor output=json_sensor | spath path=value output=json_value | spath path=source output=json_source | eval clean_time=replace(json_timestamp,"Z","+0000") | eval event_time=coalesce(strptime(clean_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N%z"),strptime(clean_time,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")) | eval _time=coalesce(event_time,_time) | eval reading=tonumber(json_value) | where json_source="open_meteo" AND json_device_id="station_01" AND json_sensor IN ("ambient_temperature","wind_speed") AND isnotnull(reading) | where (json_sensor="ambient_temperature" AND reading>=-10 AND reading<=55) OR (json_sensor="wind_speed" AND reading>=0 AND reading<=150) | eval metric=case(json_sensor="ambient_temperature","Temperature C",json_sensor="wind_speed","Wind km/h",true(),json_sensor) | timechart span=1m avg(reading) by metric
